access.edition_or_version: Hogarth Press / Oxford World's Classics edition

mechanics.premise: A high-society London woman prepares to host an evening party over the course of a single day, intertwined mentally with a shell-shocked war veteran.
mechanics.reader_promise: Intimate, luminous immersion into the textures of human consciousness, memory, regret, and post-war psychological trauma.
mechanics.opening: 'Mrs. Dalloway said she would buy the flowers herself.' Clarissa steps out into the bustling morning streets of Westminster.
mechanics.point_of_view: Free indirect discourse fluidly tunneling across multiple character minds.
mechanics.character_system: Clarissa Dalloway (bourgeois hostess), Septimus Warren Smith (traumatized soldier double), Peter Walsh (former suitor), Sally Seton (past love).
mechanics.conflict_and_stakes: Preservation of the private soul against institutional coercion, social conformity, and mental disintegration.
mechanics.structure: Single-day unspooling in post-WWI London structured by the chiming of Big Ben and psychological association.
mechanics.scene_movement: Westminster streets, Bond Street florists, Regent's Park, Harley Street medical offices, Clarissa's evening party.
mechanics.dialogue: Brief social exchanges charged with immense psychological subtext and unsaid interior retrospection.
mechanics.setting: London in June 1923, vibrating with modern traffic, post-war quietude, and imperial architecture.
mechanics.style_and_devices: Tunneling process, free indirect style, stream of consciousness, motif of Big Ben chiming leaden circles.
mechanics.emotional_progression: Exhilaration of morning life -> afternoon reckoning with past youth -> shock of Septimus's suicide -> transcendent clarity.
mechanics.suspense_or_anticipation: Internal tension of whether Septimus will be institutionalized and whether Clarissa's party will succeed or collapse under social falsity.
mechanics.climax: Dr. Bradshaw arrives at Clarissa's party announcing Septimus's suicide; Clarissa withdraws to a small room to contemplate death.
mechanics.ending: Clarissa recognizes kinship with Septimus's defiance of compromise, returns to her guests; Peter Walsh observes: 'For there she was.'
mechanics.conventions: Modernist psychological novel; replaces chronological plot mechanics with temporal fluidity of consciousness.
mechanics.innovation_or_subversion: Creates a profound structural double between two characters who never meet in life, making suicide an act of preserved communication.
mechanics.critical_reception: Heralded as one of the defining triumphs of modernist fiction and formal innovation.
mechanics.audience_reception: Lasting canonical text studied worldwide for narrative point of view and lyrical interiority.
